aboutConfig.heroSubtitle: A sustainable future for packaging. Engineered with purpose, manufactured for impact.
aboutConfig.missionQuote: We engineered our circular manufacturing framework around a simple premise: commercial packaging can protect goods and elevate brands without ever polluting our natural world.
aboutConfig.storyParagraph1: Founded to combat the global crisis of single-use plastic waste, Ecotex Inc. operates as a vertically integrated packaging manufacturer. We specialize in high-tensile reusable non-woven polypropylene totes, certified compostable cornstarch blends, and reclaimed post-industrial cotton wiping textiles.
aboutConfig.storyParagraph2: From our corporate headquarters in California to state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facilities, every product is subjected to rigorous tensile testing, automated ultrasonic seam welding, and non-toxic water-based printing. We empower grocery retailers, boutique lifestyle brands, and logistics operations across the globe to achieve zero-waste compliance with full chain-of-custody audit trails.
